bio_en: Hakob Zavriev was born in Tiflis in 1866 into a family of Georgian nobility and graduated from the Military Medical Academy in St Petersburg in 1892. In 1904, through Russian diplomatic channels, he took a medical team to Erzurum to aid both Armenians and Turks, and he took part in ARF congresses and gatherings in these years, studying Armenian literature and history at Etchmiadzin in 1906. He played a large political role in the ARF and Armenian national life. He died in Moscow, 'a victim of a great misunderstanding' arising from Soviet Russia's policy, in 1920.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year inferred from #66, published in the Yerevan 'Haraj' 2nd year no. 79 (spring 1920) as a posthumous appreciation - verify.
